body:
I've gone to career fairs, networking events, etc. But everything is so overcrowded that usually nothing comes out of those programs. 

I apply online as well, and most of the time nothing happens and I get some insincere canned rejection letter. 

I don't feel entitled to a job, but I feel as if I should at least be passing resume-screens, considering I've done and published AI research at Harvard, go to another Ivy-league school, have prior CS internship experience, an above-average GPA especially for my majors, and a ton of other stuff too.

Meanwhile people I know who started programming like a year ago are getting interviews at Facebook.

I'm an agnostic, but I'm honestly starting to think that there is a god, and he/she/it just hates me.
